prompt_en: Photorealistic vertical intimate medium-close documentary photograph of one explicitly adult original character during a private late-night snack ritual at a small home kitchen window seat under one warm lamp. The character is an original woman. She is a pretty and cute adult woman in her late twenties with a polished bishoujo-inspired character-design read: harmonious refined adult facial features, clear lively almond-shaped eyes at realistic adult scale behind slim oval glasses, a softly expressive mouth, glossy well-kept dark bobbed hair, and cohesive soft-cardigan styling. Her appealing face is the first-read focus. Her baseline is meticulous composure and a private rule of exactly three red-apple slices. Show catching the third fruit slice after it slips past the plate edge, pinched outside the plate before it falls as one pleased mouth corner escapes. The frame must visibly contain two aligned fruit slices, one open crescent gap, a wet skid mark over the chipped rim, and the third slice hanging outside and below it. Her hand lunges sideways beyond the plate rather than descending over it; thumb and index finger pinch only the lower tip of the vertically hanging slice, clearly reading as an abrupt catch rather than deliberate placement. Her tracking lively eyes widen a fraction while one mouth corner lifts involuntarily before she restores her severe expression. The fresh wet skid mark and still-open gap record the recovery already underway. Her adult beautiful face, glossy straight bob, oval glasses, cardigan, and severe baseline remain consistent. Her face, sideways-catching fingers, vertical slice below the rim, open gap, and wet skid mark share one tight focal plane. Warm lamp light gives her eyes clear catchlights and uses reflected apple color to bind face, hand, and worn plate; natural skin texture, one loose hair, creased knit, contact shadows, and shallow falloff. Nonsexual private humor, observed rather than posed.
